* '''Original''' ([[Planetary Defenses (V)]]): Slip in the PC's Virtual Set 3 sheet, official text as of 1 August 2016<ref name="ms2016">Players Committee, Virtual Set 3 sheet PDF <code>Set-3.pdf</code>, “Official text as of August 1, 2016” (file created 3 August 2016), page 3, slip “•Planetary Defenses (V)” ([https://web.archive.org/web/20160806182910/http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-3.pdf Internet Archive copy of 6 August 2016]).</ref>: “Plays on any site. This location may not be targeted by Proton Bombs. Unless Death Star: Docking Bay 327 on table, Commence Primary Ignition is canceled.” Printed: a partial slip (the “DEFENSIVE SHIELD” band and the game-text box only), to be laid over the Decipher card; lower-left name “•Planetary Defenses”; no errata mark. The PC first released this card with [[Virtual Set 3]] on 4 December 2015; the slips of that first release do not survive in the Internet Archive, so this sheet is the earliest surviving text. The PC re-issued the PDF on 30 May 2017 with this slip unchanged (pixel-identical)<ref name="ms2017">The same PDF re-issued by the PC (file created 30 May 2017), page 3 ([https://web.archive.org/web/20170705020258/http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-3.pdf Internet Archive copy of 5 July 2017]).</ref>.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Planetary Defenses (V) (Errata)]]): Card image published 8 July 2018<ref name="v1-1">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/022435b/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual3-Light/large/planetarydefenses.gif planetarydefenses.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b 022435b] (8 July 2018, “Set 9 load”).</ref>: “Plays on any site. This location may not be targeted by Proton Bombs. Unless Death Star: Docking Bay 327 on table, Commence Primary Ignition is canceled.” Printed: no errata mark; lower-left name “•Planetary Defenses”. The PC first released this card with [[Virtual Set 3]] on 4 December 2015. The PC's Holotable image set starts on 8 July 2018, so this is the earliest surviving PC card image; whether the 2015 release slip had the same words is not shown by it. The image prints the Virtual Set 3 set icon. '''Errata mark:''' this image prints no errata mark but is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026). '''What changed:''' Same words as the slip above. This is the first PC card image of the card (the PC's Holotable image set starts on 8 July 2018): the whole card is drawn, with frame, picture and icons, instead of a print-and-cut slip. A visibly different publication, so a version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026).
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Planetary Defenses (V) (Errata 2)]]): Card image published 1 November 2018<ref name="v2-1">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/3d4777c/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual3-Light/large/planetarydefenses.gif planetarydefenses.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/3d4777c 3d4777c] (1 November 2018, “Shadows/Planet Def Errata”).</ref>: “Plays on any site. '''What changed:''' PC errata (commit “Shadows/Planet Def Errata”; image marked “E”): new sentence “Cancels Program Trap here.”
* '''PC-E3''' (this page): Card image published 1 December 2022<ref name="v3-1">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/eb53af7/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual3-Light/large/planetarydefenses.gif planetarydefenses.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/eb53af7 eb53af7] (1 December 2022, “Fixing case and making gifs”); high-resolution image <code>Virtual3-Light/hires/planetarydefenses.png</code>, commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/a75a24b a75a24b] (27 November 2022, “Set 3 Remastered / Hi Res”).</ref>: “Plays on any site.
